typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DEV_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID as string,
		STORAGE_WF_GUID as string,
		STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		STORAGE_NAME as string,
		STORAGE_SYS_CREATED_ON as timestamp,
		STORAGE_SYS_UPDATED_ON as timestamp,
		STORAGE_OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		DATA_CENTER_NAME as string,
		DATA_CENTER_NEIGHBORHOOD as string,
		DATA_CENTER_ZONE as string,
		U_RPT_CPU_TOTAL_CORES as string,
		U_DC_NEIGHBORHOOD as string,
		U_DC_ZONE as string,
		U_NEW_PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE as string,
		COMMON_NAME as string,
		U_DC_NEIGHBORHOOD_NAME as string,
		U_DC_ZONE_NAME as string,
		DEVICE_WF_GUID as string,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_NAME as string,
		DEVICE_NAME as string,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_GUID as string,
		OBJECT_STORAGE_TENANT_GUID as string,
		OBJECT_STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		OBJECT_STORAGE_TENANT_NAME as string,
		STORAGE_CLUSTER_GUID as string,
		STORAGE_CLUSTER_NAME as string,
		DEVICE_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		LOCATION_NAME as string,
		RNO as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ORACLESOURCE
ORACLESOURCE derive(importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		STORAGE_SYS_CREATED_ON as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		U_RPT_CPU_TOTAL_CORES as string,
		COMMON_NAME as string,
		DATA_CENTER_NAME as string,
		DEVICE_NAME as string,
		STORAGE_OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID as string,
		DATA_CENTER_NEIGHBORHOOD as string,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_GUID as string,
		OBJECT_STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		STORAGE_SYS_UPDATED_ON as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_NAME as string,
		OBJECT_STORAGE_TENANT_NAME as string,
		OBJECT_STORAGE_TENANT_GUID as string,
		STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		U_NEW_PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE as string,
		STORAGE_WF_GUID as string,
		U_DC_ZONE as string,
		DATA_CENTER_ZONE as string,
		STORAGE_NAME as string,
		U_DC_NEIGHBORHOOD as string,
		STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		U_DC_ZONE_NAME as string,
		DEVICE_WF_GUID as string,
		STORAGE_CLUSTER_NAME as string,
		STORAGE_CLUSTER_GUID as string,
		DEVICE_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		LOCATION_NAME as string,
		U_DC_NEIGHBORHOOD_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		STORAGE_SYS_CREATED_ON,
		U_RPT_CPU_TOTAL_CORES,
		COMMON_NAME,
		DATA_CENTER_NAME,
		DEVICE_NAME,
		STORAGE_OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID,
		DATA_CENTER_NEIGHBORHOOD,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_GUID,
		OBJECT_STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		STORAGE_SYS_UPDATED_ON,
		APPLICATION_SERVICE_NAME,
		OBJECT_STORAGE_TENANT_NAME,
		OBJECT_STORAGE_TENANT_GUID,
		STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION,
		importdate,
		U_NEW_PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE,
		STORAGE_WF_GUID,
		U_DC_ZONE,
		DATA_CENTER_ZONE,
		STORAGE_NAME,
		U_DC_NEIGHBORHOOD,
		STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		U_DC_ZONE_NAME,
		DEVICE_WF_GUID,
		STORAGE_CLUSTER_NAME,
		STORAGE_CLUSTER_GUID,
		DEVICE_SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		LOCATION_NAME,
		U_DC_NEIGHBORHOOD_NAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($DEV_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> DEV
